searchText: While we're here, the gossipsub specs have changed a little, in that message-id's no longer need to be strings and can be bytes. So we don't need to base64 encode our message-id's now if we don't want. Yea I was wondering about that when going through it for the seq/sig/from stuff. Quite odd to base64 encode. This clears that up, thanks. We probably should change it, but it's more breaking, so let's discuss how it should work and how it could update in some GitHub issue. Is message ID included in the packet payload or just used locally? I think it's part of some of the gossip control type messages, let me check the spec. Not part of the main type at least It's in the payload for ihave and Iwant messages Right. Forgot about the ihave/iwant Is there byte-size savings to be had if we change? Base 64 has a `4/3` overhead, plus a few chars padding maybe Yeah in principle. Bytes would be smaller
